name: Sugar & Massacre
source:
"When I woke up, I was all alone.

The room was suddenly silent.

Was it because of what I didn't see, or because I couldn't conceive what had just happened?

I don't think I'll ever figure that out. 

Why was I so afraid, but at the same time couldn't feel anything at all?

What caused this immense pain?

Whatever it was back then…

It never left me."

-

Sugar & Massacre is a visual novel taking place in the 2100's, in the cyberpunk fictional city San Tänne - A lush, sublime sex-positive place where the revolutionary new models of sexbot androids, Lelu, are made. The massive outburst of demand for these is what draws people all over the world to come visit - however, this is not what caused our main character to go there. 
Olivia keeps her motives hidden and desperately guards part of herself from everyone around her, even close friends. It's something she holds onto so tight she's become almost blind to her own pain caused from it. 
Only thing that is certain is once she delves into what this city has in store, Olivia's life will never be the same… For better or worse.
